what: A multi-line heading starts faint at 18% text color, and on each line a band slanted at 97° sweeps in from the left and fills it. The leading 16% of the band is the accent color (a red tip), so only the spot being filled glows red, and the area it has passed becomes the original text color. Each line animates --fill-pos from −16 to 111 over 1s expo.out, and the next line starts 1s later (after the previous line is full). By default it plays once when it reaches 80% of the screen, and with mode: scrub it is tied to scroll.

options.[data-fx-part=line]: Lines to fill (multiple) — if empty, the whole element is one line
options.mode: ”enter” (default) once when it enters the screen · ”scrub” tied to scroll
options.lag: Gap (s) before the next line starts, default same as dur
options.ease: Curve per line, default expo.out (also accepts the ”0.16,1,0.3,1” form)
options.end: End of mode: scrub, default bottom 40%
options.rest: Faint level before fill (text color opacity), default .18
